summary: ByteStash is a self-hosted pastebin and file storage application featuring a straightforward web interface. It provides core functionality for text and file sharing, including syntax highlighting, optional user authentication, and public link generation.
goodFor: It suits individuals or teams who need a private, self-hosted alternative to public pastebins for sharing code snippets and small files.
watchOut: The software occupies a crowded category with many mature alternatives, meaning you should weigh its feature set carefully against more established tools.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volume mounts for stored data and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
